limitations: Workspace Cargo.lock is overinclusive, not an exact linked-dependency inventory.
Metadata SPDX expressions, filenames and headers are evidence, not an automated redistribution approval.
Native embedded dependencies and compiler/runtime attribution need a consolidated applicability review.
A lack of a standalone license filename does not prove a licensing violation.
